title: The path for a doubtful email

props.takeaway: When in doubt, report: it is never the wrong move
props.source: Information security policy, Quillon Freight (internal policy, fictional)

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: When an email surprises you, ask: does it want a password, money, or a file?

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: If so, or if the sender or the link looks wrong, report it. If not, carry on.

lines.speaker: guide
lines.text: Then, if you clicked, call the desk. If not, you're done: we take it from here.
